title: Jewish Radical Traditions of the SWANA Region w/ Emanuel Ovadia
author: CounterPunch.org
content:
In this episode of Counterpunch Radio, Rebecca Maria Goldschmidt speaks with
Emanuel Ovadia, a researcher and educator on radical Jewish traditions in the
Southwest Asia and North Africa (SWANA) region. Emanuel shares stories of
Muslim-Jewish relations, the politics of language, and the Jewish radical
traditions outside of the typical "Ashkenormative" European or American Jewish
left. We discuss how the multi-lingual, transnational, and transcultural
history of the region debunks zionist myths of Jewish supremacy, and the
importance of uplifting the cultural memory of ancestors who may have been
assimilated into "Israeli" or other colonial identities across the SWANA
region. You can find Emanuel's quarterly zine, Gazoz De Frambuaz, and his
Instagram at <https://linktr.ee/gdframbuaz>.

The post [Jewish Radical Traditions of the SWANA Region w/ Emanuel
Ovadia](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/02/27/jewish-radical-traditions-of-

[CounterPunch.org](https://www.counterpunch.org).
